intro: Settings are saved on this device only.

language.title: Language
language.intro: The language of the portal's buttons and pages.

access.title: Access arrangements
access.intro: Turn these on only if the school has granted you access arrangements.

extraTime.label: 25% extra time
extraTime.hint: Timed papers in the plan and exam end times get 25% more time.

separateRoom.label: Separate room (ACC2)
separateRoom.hint: The Today page shows when your next exam starts in ACC2.

load.title: Study time per day
load.intro: Minutes of study for each weekday, including the 15 min recall. An empty box keeps the time from the study schedule (usually Mon–Thu 150, Fri 120, Sat–Sun 270 min; a few days differ). A number replaces that time on every ordinary day of that weekday; timed papers keep their full length. Exam days always keep their evening time from the schedule. 0 makes it a rest day.
load.planned: Planned from today with these settings: {{time}}.

transfer.title: Move your progress
transfer.intro: Progress is saved only in this browser. To carry on on another device or at another address of the portal, copy the code here and paste it there.

export.title: Your progress code
export.label: Code with your progress and settings:
export.nothing: Nothing is saved on this device yet, so this code is empty:
export.copied: Copied. Paste it into Settings on the other device.
export.manual: This browser cannot copy by itself. The code is selected: copy it with Ctrl+C (⌘C on a Mac), or press and hold it on a phone.
export.blocked: This browser does not let the portal read its saved progress (private mode or blocked storage), so there is no code to copy.

import.title: Paste a code from another device
import.label: Progress code:
import.ready: The code is valid: made on {{date}} (Dubai time), saved items: {{items}}.
import.warning: Importing replaces the progress and settings on this device with the ones in the code.
import.confirm: Replace the progress on this device? This cannot be undone.
import.done: Progress imported (saved items: {{items}}). The plan has been recalculated.
import.failed: This browser did not let the portal save the progress (private mode or full storage).

problem.invalid: This is not a progress code. Copy the whole code from the other device and paste it again.
problem.damaged: This code is damaged: the progress inside cannot be read.
